summary: Sol-Gel Technologies filed a Form 6-K containing its press release for Q1 2026 financial results and corporate updates. The filing reports an oversubscribed underwritten offering raising ~$33.1 million gross proceeds from healthcare specialist investors, a Notice of Allowance for a method-of-use patent extending protection for patidegib to 2044, and an exclusive license agreement with Sun Pharmaceutical for TWYNEO in India. There is no transaction event—no acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or strategic review. The underwritten offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. The filing is a standard quarterly report.
